Ikki qadamli zanjir ;; avval yo'lovchi qanday tanlashi ;; keyin undan kelib chiqadigan xulosa
A service that runs only every forty minutes will stay empty however little it costs, because the waiting time is the true fare for anyone who is late for work.
Aniq vaziyat va aniq vaqt oralig'i ;; bu o'ylab topilgan statistika emas, jadvaldagi raqam ;; "waiting time is the true fare" obrazli ifoda, LR ni ko'taradi
Unless cities also build separate bus lanes and increase the frequency of services, they are simply giving away seats on a network that people were already avoiding.
Fikrga qaytadi va shart qo'yadi ;; xulosadagi pozitsiyani tayyorlaydi ;; yangi g'oya qo'shmaydi

tasks.title: Nega aynan shu tartib?
tasks.instr: Har savolga guruh bilan javob bering. Bu — darsning eng muhim muhokamasi.
items: Har xatboshida nechta asosiy fikr bor?
Kirish va xulosada ham to'rt harakat bormi?
answers: Tushuntirish qoidani aytadi, misol esa o'sha qoidani ko'rsatadi. Misol oldin kelsa, o'quvchi uni nimaga misol ekanini bilmaydi.
Fikr da'vo bo'lib qoladi, isbotlanmaydi. 37-darsdagi A essayning asosiy kamchiligi aynan shu edi.
Xatboshi oilaning shanba kuni haqidagi gap bilan tugaydi va savolga qanday aloqasi borligi noaniq qoladi.
Bu yerda butun xatboshi qarshi fikr; "however" o'quvchini burilishga tayyorlaydi.
Bittadan. 2-xatboshi narx haqida, 3-xatboshi tezlik haqida; ular aralashmagan.
Yo'q. To'rt harakat faqat BODY xatboshilariga tegishli; kirish va xulosaning o'z tuzilishi bor.
why: Tartib buzilsa, TR tushadi.
Descriptor tili bilan: insufficiently developed.
Tekshiruvchi bog'lashni o'zi qilib bermaydi.
37-darsdagi qoida: bog'lovchi o'z joyida.
Bitta xatboshi — bitta fikr.
Buni adashtirmaslik kerak.
tasks.note: Doskaga yoziladi: FIKR aytadi, TUSHUNTIRISH isbotlaydi, MISOL ko'rsatadi, BOG'LASH savolga ulaydi. To'rttasi bo'lmasa — xatboshi tugamagan.

homework_intro: Bugun biz xatboshining to'rt harakatini o'rgandik: fikr, tushuntirish, misol va bog'lash — uyda ayni shu zanjirni o'z qo'lingiz bilan quradingiz.
Birinchi vazifa: ikkita tayyor topic sentence beriladi, har biriga to'liq xatboshi yozasiz; har birida kamida besh gap va to'rttala harakat bo'lsin, taxminan 25 daqiqa.
Ikkinchi vazifa: aralashgan yetti gapdan to'g'ri tartibdagi xatboshini yig'asiz va ortiqchasini chiqarib, nega ortiqcha ekanini bir jumlada yozasiz, 10 daqiqa.
Uchinchi vazifa: beshta topic sentence'ga beshta aniq misol o'ylab topasiz — raqam yoki tadqiqot emas, aniq odam va aniq holat bo'lsin, 15 daqiqa.
Uchala vazifa ham daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi; men har xatboshini to'rt harakatga ajratib, qaysi harakat yetishmayotganini chetiga yozib beraman.

homework.title: Ikkita to'liq xatboshi yozing
homework.instr: Quyidagi ikki topic sentence'ni oling va har biriga to'liq xatboshi yozing. Birinchisi: Free school buses would remove most of the morning traffic around city schools. Ikkinchisi: Raising parking prices in the centre is fairer than banning cars altogether. Har xatboshida kamida besh gap va to'rttala harakat bo'lsin.
homework.answers: Tekshirish mezoni: birinchi gap da'vomi? Tushuntirish kamida ikki qadammi? Misolda aniq odam yoki joy bormi? Oxirgi gap fikrga qaytadimi? Namuna tuzilish — 5-mashqdagi tungi avtobus xatboshisi va namuna essayning 2-xatboshisi.

homework.title: Aralashgan xatboshini tartiblang
homework.instr: Gaplarni to'g'ri tartibda ko'chiring, ortiqchasini chiqarib tashlang va nega ortiqcha ekanini bir jumlada yozing. A) Drivers who pay nothing for a parking space treat the centre as free storage. B) Free parking in the city centre is the hidden subsidy that keeps traffic high. C) A shop owner who arrives at eight and leaves at seven occupies one space for eleven hours without paying anything. D) Public transport in most cities has improved over the last ten years. E) That space could otherwise serve twenty short visits by customers who actually spend money. F) Charging for parking therefore does not punish drivers; it simply asks them to pay for land they are already using. G) Land in the centre is the most expensive land a city owns, yet it is given away by the hour.
homework.answers: To'g'ri tartib: B (fikr) - G (tushuntirish, birinchi qadam) - A (tushuntirish, ikkinchi qadam) - C (misol) - E (misolning natijasi) - F (bog'lash). Ortiqcha gap: D — jamoat transportining yaxshilanishi boshqa g'oya, bu xatboshi esa bepul parkovka haqida.

homework.title: Misol banki
homework.instr: Quyidagi beshta topic sentence'ga beshta ANIQ misol yozing; har misolda aniq odam yoki oila, aniq joy va aniq harakat bo'lsin. Raqam yoki tadqiqot o'ylab topmang. 1) Covered, well-lit bus stops attract passengers as effectively as new buses do. 2) Delivery vans block narrow city streets more often than private cars do. 3) A city that charges for parking should spend the money on its buses, not on new roads. 4) Free travel helps students more than any other group. 5) Shops on a street closed to cars usually take more money, not less.
homework.answers: Yaxshi misolning uchta belgisi bor: aniq odam (a nurse, a parent, a first-year student), aniq joy yoki vaqt (at one in the morning, two kilometres from the school gate), aniq harakat (leaves the car at home, lets the child cycle). Namuna: A first-year student who travels in from a village four days a week spends a large part of her monthly allowance on transport. Misolda "many people" yoki "some studies show" bo'lsa — qayta yoziladi.

normativ: To'rttala harakat bor, har birida kamida besh gap
Tartib to'g'ri, ortiqcha gap sababi bilan chiqarilgan
Besh misol, har birida aniq odam va aniq holat

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Quick Conclusions — uch daqiqada ikki gapli xulosa
lessons.grammar_topic: Xulosa xatboshisi — ikki gap, uch daqiqa: pozitsiyani yangi so'z bilan takrorlash va yopish
lessons.vocab_topic: Jamlanma va takror farqi; xulosaga yangi fikr kirmaydi; vaqt tugayotgandagi favqulodda xulosa
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — savollar, namuna essay, barcha xulosa variantlari va mashq bandlari shu dars uchun Jony Academy tomonidan yangidan yozilgan; mezon nomlari rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) dan. Mavzu oilasi: ISH VA BANDLIK (to'rt kunlik ish haftasi, avtomatlashtirish, uydan ishlash, nafaqa yoshi).
objectives: Xulosani IKKI gapda va UCH daqiqada yozishni odatga aylantirish.
1-gap: pozitsiyani YANGI so'z bilan takrorlash va ikki body fikrini bitta gapga jamlash.
2-gap: yopuvchi gap — natija, shart yoki tavsiya; yangi fikr emas.
Jamlanma (summary) bilan takrorni (repetition) farqlash: kirishni ko'chirish nega ball qo'shmaydi.
Xulosaga yangi fikr kiritish, pozitsiyani yumshatish va "It depends" bilan tugatish — uchala xatoni tanib olish.
Vaqt tugayotganda bir gapli favqulodda xulosa yozib, essayni tugallangan holda topshirish.
materials: 4-mashq varaqasi "To'rt reja va to'rt xulosa" — har juftlikka 1 nusxa (12 kishilik guruhga 6 nusxa); to'rt reja chap ustunda, to'rtta xulosa (1-4) o'ng ustunda aralash tartibda bosilgan.
Namuna essay nusxasi (quyidagi reading bloki) — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa; oxirgi xatboshisi ramka bilan ajratilgan, yoniga bo'sh ustun: "qaysi gap nima qilyapti".
Doskaga darsdan OLDIN yozib qo'yiladi: "1-gap = pozitsiya + ikki sabab, 2-gap = yopuvchi gap, jami 3 daqiqa, 35-50 so'z" va yonida "XULOSAGA KIRMAYDI: yangi fikr / kirishning nusxasi / It depends".
2-mashq uchun A4 da bosilgan "Oltita zaif xulosa" varaqasi — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa, yonida "nimasi noto'g'ri" ustuni bo'sh.
5-mashq uchun taymer (telefon sekundomeri yoki devor soati) va uchta savol kartochkasi — matni 5-mashqda, har juftlikka uchtadan qirqib beriladi.
timeline: 40 va 41-darslar eslatiladi; doskadagi shart o'qiladi: 2 gap, 3 daqiqa, 35-50 so'z
Xulosa nima qiladi va nima qilmaydi
Uch taqiq doskaga yoziladi; tugallanmagan essay jarimasi tushuntiriladi
1-mashq birga bajariladi, har qism doskada belgilanadi
2-mashq: varaqadagi oltita xulosa, har biriga tashxis va mezon
3-mashq: kirish gapi va xulosa varianti yonma-yon yoziladi
Reading bloki: oxirgi xatboshi qismlarga ajratiladi, so'ng ataylab buziladi
Varaqa bilan juftlikda; har tanlovga sabab aytiladi
3 daqiqa, 2 daqiqa 30 soniya, 2 daqiqa; har raunddan keyin juftlik tekshiradi
Bir gapli xulosa doskada yoziladi; vazifa aytiladi

intro: Xulosa uchun alohida ball yo'q, lekin xulosasiz essay tugallanmagan hisoblanadi va Task Response darhol tushadi. Tekshiruvchi oxirgi xatboshini o'qib, "bu odam nima demoqchi edi" degan savolga javob topishi kerak.

40 daqiqa shunday taqsimlanadi: 5 reja, 4 kirish, 22 ikkita body, 3 xulosa, 6 tekshirish. Xulosaga 3 daqiqadan ortiq vaqt ketsa, tekshirish vaqti yo'qoladi — bu esa GRA dagi oddiy xatolarni tuzatilmagan qoldiradi.
Xulosa faqat IKKI gap. 1-gap: pozitsiyani YANGI so'z bilan takrorlash va ikki body xatboshining javobini bitta gapga jamlash. 2-gap: yopuvchi gap — natija, shart yoki tavsiya.

JAMLANMA va TAKROR farqi shu: takror — kirishdagi gapni qayta yozish (bir xil so'z, bir xil tuzilish); jamlanma — ikki body xatboshida ISBOTLANGAN narsani bir gapda siqib aytish. Kirishda "I believe X" deyilgan bo'lsa, xulosada X o'sha holicha emas, isbotdan keyingi ko'rinishida turadi: "X, provided that Y".

Xulosaga YANGI FIKR kirmaydi. Yangi fikr aytilsa, tekshiruvchi uni ochilmagan fikr deb hisoblaydi va Task Response tushadi: essay yangi mavzu bilan tugab qoladi. Xayolingizga ajoyib fikr kelsa ham — qalamni to'xtating, u fikr bu essayga kech keldi.

Pozitsiya kirishda qanday bo'lsa, xulosada ham SHUNDAY bo'lishi shart. 37-darsdagi A essay aynan shu yerda yiqilgan edi: kirishda "maybe", xulosada "It depends on the situation". Ikkala tomonni birdek yoqlab tugatish — pozitsiya yo'qligining belgisi.
Signpost bitta bo'ladi: In my view / Overall / On balance / To conclude. Uchtasini ketma-ket yozish ("In conclusion, to sum up, finally") — CC bo'yicha mexanik bog'lanish belgisi.

Vaqt tugayotgan bo'lsa (2 daqiqadan kam qoldi): BIR gapli xulosa yozing — "Overall, + pozitsiya + eng kuchli sabab". Bir gapli xulosa xulosasiz essaydan ancha yuqori: birinchisi tugallangan, ikkinchisi tugallanmagan.
Xulosa hajmi — 35-50 so'z. 25 so'zdan kam bo'lsa odatda ikki body jamlanmagan; 70 so'zdan oshsa body qayta aytilyapti degani.
formulas: Yangi fikr / kirish nusxasi / It depends
Vaqt tugadi — qalam qo'yiladi, keyin tekshiriladi
presentation: Xulosaga alohida ball beriladimi?
Yo'q. Lekin xulosasiz essay tugallanmagan sanaladi va Task Response keskin tushadi.
Xulosani kirishdan ko'chirsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. Bir xil so'z bilan takrorlash LR ni tushiradi. Ma'no o'sha, so'z boshqa bo'lsin.
Xulosada misol keltirsam-chi?
Kerak emas. Misol body xatboshiniki. Xulosada misol paydo bo'lsa, u ochilmagan yangi fikrga o'xshab qoladi.
Yangi fikr aytsam nima bo'ladi?
TR tushadi: essay ochilmagan fikr bilan tugaydi. Fikr yaxshi bo'lsa ham — bu essayga kech.
Ikkala tomonni birdek yoqlab tugatsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. "Both sides are right" va "It depends" — pozitsiya yo'qligining belgisi, 6.0 chegarasi.
Vaqtim tugadi, nima qilay?
Bir gapli xulosa: "Overall, + pozitsiya + eng kuchli sabab". 20 soniya yetadi va essay tugallangan bo'ladi.
Ikkinchi body xatboshini tugatolmadim, xulosa yozaymi?
Ha, avval xulosa. Yarim xatboshi va xulosa — xulosasiz essaydan yuqori baholanadi.
Xulosa necha so'z bo'lsin?
35-50 so'z. Kam bo'lsa jamlanma yo'q, ko'p bo'lsa body qaytarilyapti.
notes: Bu dars 40-darsning (kirish) juftligi: o'sha yerdagi "ikki gap, to'rt daqiqa" shartining oxirgi ko'rinishi. 41-darsdagi body xatboshilari bilan qo'shilsa, o'quvchida butun essay skeleti tayyor bo'ladi.

Ishlatilgan mavzu oilasi: ISH VA BANDLIK — to'rt kunlik ish haftasi, mashina o'rnini egallagan ishchini qayta o'qitish, uydan ishlash, nafaqa yoshi, ish soatlarini qonun bilan cheklash, birinchi ish o'rni. 36-37 darslarda ta'lim, 38 va 43-44 va 47-48 da meros va shahar markazi, 39-41 da transport, 45-46 da sog'liq mavzusi ishlatilgan — shuning uchun bugun ish va bandlik olindi, takrorlanish yo'q.
Ustoz xulosani o'zi yozib bermasin: avval o'quvchi yozadi, keyin doskada tuzatiladi. Eng tez o'rganiladigan joy — o'quvchi o'z xulosasidagi "It depends" ni o'zi topib olgan payt.

2-mashqdagi oltita zaif xulosa ataylab markaz o'quvchilarida eng ko'p uchraydigan variantlar: kirishning nusxasi, yangi fikr, ikki tomonni birdek yoqlash, bo'sh umumiy gap, uzun qayta hikoya, signpost to'plami.
5-mashqda vaqt QISQARADI: 3 -> 2.5 -> 2 daqiqa. Maqsad chiroyli gap emas, ODAT. Birinchi raundda ulgurmaslik normal holat.
Dars oxirida doskada bitta gap qolsin: "Xulosa yangi narsa aytmaydi — u aytilganni yopadi". Uyga vazifa shu gap bilan beriladi.
mistakes: "In conclusion, to sum up, finally" — mexanik

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Ikki gapli xulosa — shakl
class_ex.instr: Ustoz namuna xulosani gap-gap ochadi, o'quvchilar har qismni daftarga sxema qilib ko'chiradi. SAVOL: Some people believe that companies should move to a four-day working week without reducing pay.
answers: In my view, a shorter week is worth pursuing, but not everywhere at once ...
... firms whose output depends on thinking should move first, and shift-based sectors need tax relief beforehand.
In that order, the reform protects services that cannot shrink their hours and still frees a day for most employees.
In my view / Overall / On balance / To conclude
why: Kirishdagi fikr — boshqa so'z bilan va isbotdan keyingi ko'rinishda.
Ikki xatboshi BIR gapga siqiladi, qaytadan tushuntirilmaydi.
Yangi fikr emas — aytilganning natijasi.
Bittasi yetadi; uchtasi ketma-ket — CC belgisi.
Uzun xulosa tekshirish vaqtini yeydi.
class_ex.note: Sxema daftarga shunday yoziladi: 1-gap = POZITSIYA va ikki sabab; 2-gap = YOPUVCHI GAP. Shu ikki qator imtihongacha ishlatiladi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Bu xulosa nimasi bilan yiqiladi?
class_ex.instr: Varaqadagi oltita xulosa bitta savolga yozilgan: Some people believe that companies should move to a four-day working week without reducing pay. Har biriga tashxis qo'ying va mezonni ayting.
items: In conclusion, some people think a four-day week is good and other people think it is bad. Both sides have strong arguments.
In conclusion, companies should move to a four-day working week without reducing pay because it is a good idea.
To sum up, in conclusion, finally, I want to say that a shorter week is better.
Overall, a shorter week is worth trying. Moreover, the government should also reduce taxes on small businesses and build more childcare centres.
In conclusion, as I said in the introduction, I strongly believe that a four-day week is the best solution for all companies in every country.
To conclude, it depends on the company and on the situation, so it is difficult to say.
answers: Uchta signpost ketma-ket, ustiga bo'sh gap
Kirishning nusxasi va haddan tashqari umumiy da'vo
why: TR — o'z fikri aytilmagan, 6.0 chegarasi.
LR va TR — jamlanma emas, takror.
CC — mexanik bog'lanish.
TR — essay ochilmagan fikr bilan tugadi.
LR va TR — 45-darsdagi overgeneralising xatosi.
TR — 37-darsdagi A essay xatosi.
class_ex.note: Har tashxisdan keyin o'quvchi zaif xulosani BIR gapda tuzatib aytsin. Tuzatish doskaga yozilmaydi — og'zaki va tez.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Jamlanma va takror — yonma-yon
class_ex.instr: Chapda kirishdagi thesis gapi. O'ngga xulosa varianti yozing: ma'no o'sha, so'z boshqa, ustiga body da isbotlangan shart qo'shilgan.
items: I largely agree that a four-day week would benefit both employees and the firms that employ them.
I believe that employers, not the state, should pay for retraining workers replaced by machines.
While home working suits experienced staff, I believe junior employees need time in an office.
I disagree that raising the retirement age blocks opportunities for younger workers.
In my opinion, governments should set a legal limit on weekly working hours.
answers: In my view, a shorter week is worth pursuing, provided that it begins in the sectors where output is not measured in hours.
On balance, the cost of retraining belongs with the companies that benefit from automation, since the alternative is a bill paid by everyone else.
Overall, remote work is the better arrangement for most established employees, but new staff still learn fastest beside colleagues they can watch.
To conclude, older employees leaving later does not close the door on younger ones, because experienced staff and new graduates rarely compete for the same posts.
In my view, a legal ceiling on working hours remains necessary, as firms under commercial pressure rarely impose such limits on themselves.
why: Bir xil pozitsiya, boshqa so'z, ustiga shart.
"Employers" -> "the companies that benefit from automation".
Ikki tomon saqlandi, pozitsiya aniq qoldi.
Inkor pozitsiya sababi bilan yopildi.
"Set a legal limit" -> "a legal ceiling ... remains necessary".
class_ex.note: Qoida: xulosa kirishdan UZUNROQ emas, ANIQROQ bo'ladi — unda body da isbotlangan shart yoki chegara ko'rinadi.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Rejani o'z xulosasiga moslang
class_ex.instr: Chapda to'rt essay rejasi (savol, pozitsiya, ikki body fikri). O'ngdagi to'rt xulosadan har rejaga mosini toping va NEGA shu ekanini ayting.
items: A REJA. Savol: employers should be required to retrain workers replaced by machines. Pozitsiya: agree. BODY 1 — ishsizlikning narxi butun jamiyatga tushadi. BODY 2 — kadrni tashqaridan izlashdan ko'ra o'zinikini qayta o'qitgan arzon.

B REJA. Savol: the retirement age should be raised. Pozitsiya: agree, but gradually. BODY 1 — tajriba juda erta yo'qotilyapti. BODY 2 — yosh xodimlar boshqa lavozimlarga kiradi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri raqobat yo'q.

C REJA. Savol: do the advantages of working from home outweigh the disadvantages? Pozitsiya: advantages outweigh, but not for new staff. BODY 1 — yo'lda ketadigan vaqt tejaladi, mahsuldorlik oshadi. BODY 2 — yangi xodim yonida o'rganadigan odam bo'lmasa sekin o'sadi.

D REJA. Savol: should governments limit weekly working hours by law? Pozitsiya: agree, cheklov qonun bilan bo'lsin. BODY 1 — uzoq ish haftasi sog'liq va xavfsizlikka zarar. BODY 2 — bozor bosimi ostida kompaniya o'zini o'zi cheklamaydi.
why: Ikkala sabab ham (jamiyat narxi va kompaniya foydasi) bitta gapga jamlangan.
"As long as ..." sharti — rejadagi "gradually" ning xulosadagi ko'rinishi.
Ikkinchi gap aynan "junior staff" chegarasini yopadi.
"Rarely set such limits themselves" — ikkinchi body fikrining siqilgan shakli.
class_ex.note: Tekshirish usuli: xulosani o'qib, rejadagi POZITSIYA va IKKI SABABni topish. Topilmasa — bu xulosa boshqa essayniki. Har juftlik javobini sabab bilan aytadi.
box: 1-xulosa. Overall, the firms that replace people with machines should also pay to prepare them for new work, because a workforce that cannot move into the next job becomes a cost the whole country carries. Handled this way, automation raises output without leaving a generation behind.

2-xulosa. In my view, a later retirement is reasonable as long as older employees are offered lighter or part-time roles, since experience is lost far too cheaply at sixty. Managed carefully, this protects pension funds and the young people entering the same companies alike.

3-xulosa. On balance, the advantages of working from home outweigh the drawbacks for established staff, whose output tends to rise once the daily commute disappears. Younger employees, however, still need regular time beside colleagues they can learn from, and any sensible policy should say so.

4-xulosa. To conclude, a legal ceiling on weekly hours remains necessary, because companies under commercial pressure rarely set such limits themselves. Without one, the longest week quietly becomes the normal week for everyone in the industry.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Taymer bilan uch raund
class_ex.instr: Har raundda savol va pozitsiya beriladi, o'quvchi FAQAT xulosa yozadi. Vaqt tugaganda qalam qo'yiladi. Har raunddan keyin juftlik tekshiruv ro'yxati bo'yicha baholaydi.
items: 1-raund, 3 daqiqa. Savol: Some companies now allow employees to choose their own working hours. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages? Pozitsiya: advantages outweigh, but core hours are needed.

2-raund, 2 daqiqa 30 soniya. Savol: Some people think that robots will make many jobs disappear and that governments should slow down automation. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Pozitsiya: disagree with slowing it down, agree with protecting workers.

3-raund, 2 daqiqa. Savol: In many countries young people find it difficult to get their first job. What are the causes and what could be done? Pozitsiya: sabab — tajriba va boshlang'ich lavozim yo'q; chora — haqli amaliyot va soliq yengilligi.
Har raunddan keyingi tekshiruv ro'yxati (juftlikda, 1 daqiqa)
answers: On balance, letting staff choose their own hours brings more gains than problems, since people concentrate best at different times of day. A short band of shared hours in the middle of the day is enough to keep teams working together.

In my view, holding back automation would simply move the advantage to countries that do not, so the sensible response is to protect workers rather than machines. Funded retraining, not delay, is what keeps a workforce employable.

Overall, the difficulty young people face comes less from a lack of ability than from a lack of first posts in which ability can be shown. Paid internships and tax relief for firms that create entry-level roles would open that first door.
1) Ikki gapmi? 2) Pozitsiya aniqmi? 3) Yangi fikr yo'qmi? 4) Kirishdan so'zma-so'z ko'chirilmaganmi? 5) 35-50 so'zmi?
why: Pozitsiya va shart, keyin yopuvchi gap.
Yangi fikr yo'q — ikki body jamlangan.
SITUATION turi: sabab ham, chora ham bitta jamlanmada.
Beshtasiga ham "ha" bo'lsa — xulosa tayyor.
class_ex.note: Vaqt qisqaradi: 3 -> 2.5 -> 2 daqiqa. Ulgurmagan o'quvchiga ayting: imtihonda ham aynan shu bosim bo'ladi, shuning uchun mashq shu tezlikda qilinadi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — xulosa qanday ishlaydi
readings.qtype: DISCUSSION va OPINION savoli, to'liq essay
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (Band 7.5 darajasida yozilgan, 271 so'z; xulosasi 2 gap, 50 so'z)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people believe that companies should move to a four-day working week without reducing pay. Others argue that this would damage productivity and cost jobs. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: The idea of compressing the working week into four days, with salaries left untouched, has moved from the margins of debate into serious discussion in a number of countries. Although the risks for smaller firms are real, I believe that a shorter week would benefit both employees and the organisations that employ them.

Supporters argue that most office work is limited not by hours but by concentration. Long weeks encourage staff to stretch tasks out, to attend meetings that decide nothing, and to spend the final afternoon clearing an inbox rather than producing anything of value. A firm that removes a day usually finds that the meetings disappear first and that the work which genuinely matters is still finished. Employers also report that rested staff resign less often, which saves the considerable expense of recruiting and training replacements.

The opposing case rests on the industries where output is tied directly to time. A bus cannot be driven, a patient cannot be treated and a production line cannot be run in fewer hours simply because a policy has changed, so hospitals, factories and transport companies would have to hire additional staff to cover the missing day. For a small business with narrow margins that extra wage bill may be impossible, and the likely response is either higher prices or fewer permanent contracts.

In my view, a shorter week is worth pursuing, but not everywhere at once: firms whose output depends on thinking should move first, and shift-based sectors need tax relief beforehand. In that order, the reform protects services that cannot shrink their hours and still frees a day for most employees.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Cohesive Devices and Referencing — bog'lovchilar va orqaga ishora
lessons.grammar_topic: Coherence & Cohesion mezonini ko'tarish: kerakli bog'lovchilar, ularning o'rni, this/these/such/the former/the latter va substitution
lessons.vocab_topic: Mexanik bog'lanishdan tabiiy bog'lanishga: 6.0 dan 7.0 ga

objectives: Essayda haqiqatan kerak bo'ladigan bog'lovchilarning QISQA ro'yxatini bilish: qo'shish, qarama-qarshilik, sabab-natija, misol, xulosa — har guruhga 3-4 tadan.

this, these, such, the former, the latter va olmoshlar bilan o'quvchini adashtirmasdan orqaga ishora qilish.
Yalang'och "this" ni "this + OT" ga aylantirish — 6.0 dan 7.0 ga o'tishdagi eng arzon tuzatish.
Bitta otni qayta-qayta takrorlamaslik: one/ones, do so, such, umumiy ot bilan almashtirish (substitution).

Namuna essay nusxasi ([reading] bloki): har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa, xatboshilari raqamlangan (1-4), chetida qalam uchun bo'sh maydon.
5-mashq uchun kesiladigan kartochkalar: 12 ta kartochka (6 juft — takrorli gap / almashtirilgan variant), har 2 kishiga bitta to'plam; darsdan OLDIN qaychilab qo'yiladi.
Doskaga darsdan oldin besh ustun chiziladi va sarlavhalari yoziladi: QO'SHISH — QARAMA-QARSHILIK — SABAB-NATIJA — MISOL — XULOSA. Ustunlar bo'sh qoldiriladi, 1-mashqda o'quvchilar to'ldiradi.
Doskaning chap burchagiga katta qilib yoziladi va dars oxirigacha o'chirilmaydi: "this + OT". 4-mashq va uyga vazifa shunga tayanadi.
Ikki rangli marker: namuna essayda bog'lovchilar bir rang bilan, ishoralar (this / such / the latter / it) boshqa rang bilan belgilanadi.

intro: 37-darsda Band 6 essayning CC mezonidagi asosiy kamchiligi "bog'lovchilar mexanik" edi. Bugun aynan shuni tuzatamiz. Qoida oddiy: bog'lovchi KO'P bo'lgani uchun emas, KERAKLI joyda turgani uchun ball beradi.

Tekshiruvchi bog'lovchini sanamaydi. U gaplar orasidagi MUNOSABAT to'g'ri ko'rsatilganmi, shunga qaraydi. Aslida sabab bo'lgan joyga "Moreover" qo'yilsa — bu xato, garchi bog'lovchi "chiroyli" bo'lsa ham.

Kerakli bog'lovchilar soni kam: qo'shish (in addition, also, furthermore), qarama-qarshilik (however, by contrast, although, while, whereas), sabab-natija (because, since, as a result, consequently, which means that), misol (for example, for instance, such as, in particular), xulosa (overall, on balance, in my view). Shu yigirmatacha ibora butun essayga yetadi.

Band 6 ning eng aniq belgisi — har gap yoki har xatboshining bir xil so'z bilan boshlanishi: Firstly ... Moreover ... Moreover ... Also. Jadvalda bu "mechanical" deb ataladi va CC ni 6.0 da ushlab turadi.

7.0 dagi "flexibly" so'zining amaliy ma'nosi: bog'lovchi gap boshida ham, gap ICHIDA ham tura oladi. "However, museums are expensive" o'rniga "Museums, however, are expensive" — ma'no bir xil, daraja boshqa.
Bog'lovchi — bog'lanishning faqat YARMI. Ikkinchi yarmi REFERENCING: o'quvchini oldingi gapga qaytaradigan so'zlar (this, these, such, the former, the latter, it, they, its, the two positions).

Eng ko'p uchraydigan referencing xatosi — yalang'och "this": "This is a problem" degan gapda nima problem ekani noaniq. Tuzatish bitta so'z: "This policy is a problem". Ot qo'shilishi bilan gap aniqlashadi va LR ham ko'tariladi.
the former / the latter FAQAT ikkita narsa sanalganda ishlatiladi, tartibi qat'iy: former — birinchisi, latter — ikkinchisi. Uchta narsa sanalgan bo'lsa ishlatilmaydi.
Substitution — otni takrorlamay turib unga qaytish: "a new building ... a cheaper one", "such schemes", "these measures", "do so". Bu bir vaqtning o'zida CC ni ham, LR ni ham ko'taradi.
Ogohlantirish: ishora ANIQ bo'lishi shart. Oldingi gapda ikkita ko'plik ot bo'lsa, "they" o'quvchini adashtiradi — bunday joyda otni takrorlagan yaxshiroq. Aniqlik chiroylilikdan ustun.
formulas: Avval ovoz chiqarib o'qing — kulgili eshitiladi
Har gapga: kerakmi, ko'chirilsinmi, olib tashlansinmi
This decision, this shift, these taxes
one / do so / such / umumiy ot
presentation: Nechta bog'lovchi ishlatsam bo'ladi?
Har xatboshiga 1-2 ta yetarli. 250-300 so'zli essayda jami 6-8 ta — normal. 15 ta bo'lsa, mexanik deb baholanadi.
"Firstly, Secondly, Finally" ishlatsam bo'ladimi?
Bo'ladi, lekin faqat HAQIQIY ro'yxat bo'lganda va bitta essayda bir marta. Har xatboshini "Firstly" bilan boshlash — xato.
"Moreover" umuman yomonmi?
Yo'q. Bitta essayda bir marta — normal. Ikki marta, ayniqsa ketma-ket — Band 6 ning eng tanilgan belgisi.
Bog'lovchini gap ichiga qo'ysam, vergul kerakmi?
Ha, ikki tomondan: "Museums, however, are expensive". "therefore" esa ega va fe'l orasida vergulsiz ham yuradi: "The council therefore postponed it".
"This" dan keyin har doim ot kerakmi?
Har doim emas, lekin holatlarning taxminan 90 foizida kerak. Qaysi otni qo'yishni topa olmasangiz — demak gapingiz ham hali noaniq.
the former / the latter ni uchta narsaga ishlatsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q, faqat ikkitada. Uchta bo'lsa otni takrorlang yoki "the first of these" deng.
Bir xil otni takrorlash har doim xatomi?
Yo'q. Aniqlik birinchi o'rinda. Almashtirganda ma'no chalkashsa, otni takrorlang — bu LR ni tushirmaydi.
"In conclusion" yozsam bo'ladimi?
Bo'ladi, lekin "Overall" yoki "On balance" kuchliroq eshitiladi. Muhimi — undan keyin yangi fikr emas, xulosa kelsin.
Bog'lovchilarni umuman ishlatmasam-chi?
Unda matn uzuq-yuluq bo'ladi va CC yana tushadi. Maqsad — kam, lekin aniq.
notes: Bu dars 36- va 37-darslarga tayanadi: 36 da mezonlar tushuntirilgan, 37 da Band 6 va Band 7.5 solishtirilgan. Mezonlarni qaytadan tushuntirmang — "bugun faqat CC ni ko'taramiz" deb boshlang.

MAVZU OILASI: namuna essay va sinf mashqlari — TARIXIY BINOLAR, MUZEYLAR VA SHAHAR BYUDJETI; uyga vazifa — OMMAVIY KUTUBXONALAR. Seriyaning boshqa darslarida takrorlanmasligi uchun ataylab shu oila olindi; texnologiya, atrof-muhit, jinoyat, sog'liq va ta'lim mavzulari boshqa darslarga qoldirildi.

Eng katta xavf — o'quvchi darsdan "bog'lovchi yomon ekan" degan xulosa bilan chiqishi. Yo'q: bog'lovchi kerak, lekin kam va o'z joyida. 2-mashqning tuzatilgan variantida ham bog'lovchi bor — buni alohida ta'kidlang.
Doskadagi "this + OT" qatori butun dars davomida o'chirilmasin: 4-mashq, namuna essay tahlili va uyga vazifa — uchalasi ham shunga tayanadi.
5-mashq kartochkalari darsdan oldin qaychilanadi. Vaqt kam bo'lsa kartochkasiz og'zaki ham bo'ladi, lekin albatta juftlikda bajarilsin.
Namuna essayda ataylab Samarqand va Buxoro misol qilingan: o'quvchi o'z shahri haqida yozganda ham xuddi shu qurilmalar ishlashini ko'rsating.

Kuchli guruh uchun qo'shimcha: o'quvchilar namuna essaydagi HAMMA bog'lovchini o'chirib tashlasin va matn qanchalik tushunarli qolganini tekshirsin. Ko'p qismi tushunarli qoladi — chunki asosiy bog'lanish ishoralar orqali qilingan. Bu darsning asosiy xulosasi.
Agar guruh zaif bo'lsa, 5-mashqni qisqartiring va 2-mashqqa 5 daqiqa qo'shing: haddan ziyod bog'langan xatboshi — eng ko'p foyda beradigan mashq.

why: "also" fe'ldan oldin turadi va eng tabiiy eshitiladi; "Moreover" ni essayda bir martadan ko'p ishlatmang.
Ikkalasi ham gap ichida yura oladi: "Museums, by contrast, ...".

Bu joyga "Moreover" qo'yish — darsdagi eng muhim xato.

why: Ikki tomondan vergul — eng oson va eng tez ta'sir qiladigan tuzatish.

class_ex.instr: Ustoz har juft gapni doskaga yozib, ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi. Har juft gapni o'qing. Ishora aniqmi? Aniq bo'lmasa, ot qo'shib tuzating. To'g'ri bo'lsa, nega to'g'ri ekanini ayting.
items: The council closed two libraries last year. This was unpopular.
Museums and sports halls both need funding. They are expensive to heat.
The city restored an old station and built a new gallery. The former cost twice as much.
The city built a library, a clinic and a gallery. The latter two were delayed.
Several regions have introduced heritage taxes. Such taxes are unpopular with developers.
The government increased the budget. It was a good idea.
Restoration creates local jobs. This is why many mayors support it.
Tourists spend money in nearby hotels. These bring tax revenue to the city.
answers: Both types of building are expensive to heat.
Aniqrog'i: The clinic and the gallery were delayed.
To'g'ri: "such + ot" oldingi gapdagi TURNI umumlashtirib qaytaradi
The increase was a good idea.
Ishora to'g'ri: "this" butun oldingi GAPGA qaytmoqda
These businesses bring tax revenue to the city.
why: Yalang'och "this" — aynan nima unpopular bo'lgani noaniq. Ot qo'shildi.
"They" ikkala otga ham tegishli bo'lib qolgan — o'quvchi adashadi.
Aniq IKKITA narsa sanalgan, tartib ham to'g'ri.
Uchta narsa sanalganda the former / the latter ishlatilmaydi.
"These taxes" ham to'g'ri bo'lardi, lekin "such" kengroq ma'no beradi.
"It" — hukumatmi, byudjetmi, oshirishmi? Ot bilan aniqlashtirildi.
"This is why" — yalang'och "this" ga ruxsat berilgan kam holatlardan biri.
"These" — turistlarmi, mehmonxonalarmi? Ot kerak.
class_ex.note: Doskadagi qoidaga qayting: "this + OT". Yozayotganda "this" dan keyin qaysi otni qo'yishni topa olmasangiz, demak fikringiz hali aniq emas — avval fikrni aniqlang, keyin gapni yozing.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Otni takrorlamang — substitution
class_ex.instr: Kartochkalar aralashtiriladi. Juftlik takrorli gapni topib, unga mos almashtirilgan variantni qo'yadi va nima almashtirilganini aytadi.
items: The city needs a new library because the old library is too small.
Some cities restore their old factories. Cities that do not restore their old factories lose their character.
The council approved three projects. The three projects will start in spring.
The government introduced tax breaks for restoration. Tax breaks for restoration attract private money.
Bukhara restored its covered markets. Samarkand restored its covered markets too.
The station was converted into a museum. The museum now employs forty people.
answers: The city needs a new library because the old one is too small.
Cities that do not do so lose their character.
These projects will start in spring.
The building now employs forty people.
why: "one" — takrorlangan sanaladigan otning o'rnini bosadi.
"do so" — butun fe'l guruhini almashtiradi.
"these + ot" — eng oddiy va eng ishonchli yo'l.
"such + umumiy ot" — ham takrorni oladi, ham LR ni ko'taradi.
"did the same" — takrorni butunlay yo'q qiladi.
Umumiy ot (building, site, scheme) — takrorning eng tabiiy o'rinbosari.

readings.title: Namuna essay: Tarixiy binolar va shahar byudjeti
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (Band 8 darajasi, 340 so'z)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: In many cities, historic buildings are being restored and converted into museums and cultural centres at considerable public expense. Some people argue that this money should be spent instead on services that residents use every day. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: Across the region, disused factories, railway stations and merchants' houses are being restored and reopened as museums, galleries and cultural centres. Because such projects absorb a large share of municipal budgets, many residents ask whether the same money would do more good in schools, clinics and public transport. Both the case for restoration and the residents' objection are reasonable, although in my view public money for heritage can be justified whenever the restored building is given real work to do.

The case for conversion rests on a simple asymmetry between old buildings and new ones: the former cannot be replaced once they are gone, whereas the latter can be built on almost any empty plot. A nineteenth-century station, flattened for a car park, is lost permanently; a sports hall is not. Restored buildings also tend to recover part of their own cost, since visitors who arrive for an exhibition go on to eat, shop and stay overnight nearby. Samarkand and Bukhara owe much of their tourist income to precisely this kind of investment, and the jobs it creates are local and difficult to move abroad.

Those who object, however, are not arguing against history. Their point is one of timing: a family waiting eighteen months for a clinic appointment is unlikely to feel served by a new gallery, however elegant. Municipal budgets are fixed, and every som spent on stonework is a som not spent on nurses. This objection deserves an answer rather than a dismissal, because the districts asked to wait are usually the poorest ones.

The two positions are easier to reconcile than they appear. Where a restored building is given a working function, such as a library, a clinic or a training centre inside the old walls, the city keeps its architecture and gains a service at the same time, and such conversions cost less than the two separate projects they replace. Heritage money, in other words, should be judged not by the beauty of the result but by what the building is asked to do afterwards.
paraphrases: disused factories, railway stations and merchants' houses
restored and converted into museums and cultural centres
restored and reopened as museums, galleries and cultural centres
absorb a large share of municipal budgets
services that residents use every day
in my view (1-xatboshi, o'z pozitsiyasi) / 4-xatboshidagi "Heritage money ... should be judged not by the beauty of the result but by what the building is asked to do" — xulosa gapi
glossary: to recover a cost — xarajatni qoplamoq

homework_intro: Bugun ko'rdikki, bog'lanish ikki narsadan iborat: bog'lovchi va orqaga ishora — va kuchli essayda ikkinchisi ko'proq ish bajaradi.

Birinchi vazifa — kutubxonalar haqidagi haddan ziyod bog'langan xatboshi: yettita gapning har birini tuzatasiz, keyin butun xatboshini 3-4 gapga qisqartirib daftarga ko'chirasiz; bunga 20 daqiqa yetadi.
Ikkinchi vazifada sakkizta juft gap bor: har birida noaniq ishorani ot qo'shib aniqlashtirasiz — "this" dan keyin qaysi otni qo'yishni topa olsangiz, vazifa bajarilgan hisoblanadi.
Uchinchi vazifa o'z essayingiz ustida: 37-darsda baholagan essayingizni oling, har bog'lovchini doira ichiga oling, har ishorani tagiga chizing va daftardagi uchta savolga javob yozing.

Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — bog'lovchini boshqa bog'lovchiga almashtirib qo'yish; ko'p joyda vazifa ALMASHTIRISH emas, uni butunlay OLIB TASHLASH. Uchala vazifa daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi.

homework.title: 1-vazifa: Haddan ziyod bog'langan xatboshi (kutubxonalar)
homework.instr: Har gapni tuzating: ortiqcha bog'lovchini olib tashlang yoki gap ichiga ko'chiring. Oxirida butun xatboshini 3-4 gapga qisqartirib ko'chiring.
items: Firstly, public libraries are very important in the modern world.
Moreover, they give free books to poor people.
Moreover, they have internet and computers.
Furthermore, students can study there quietly.
In addition, libraries organise events for children.
Therefore, in my opinion, governments should not close libraries.
Also, this is a big problem in many countries.
answers: Public libraries still matter, even in a city full of screens.
They give free access to books for families who could not otherwise buy them.
Many also provide internet access and computers.
Students, in addition, can study there in a quiet space that a shared flat rarely offers.
Libraries, however, do more than lend books: many run reading clubs and events for children.
For these reasons, closing a library saves less money than it appears to.
why: "Firstly" hech qanday ro'yxat boshlamayapti; "very important" — bo'sh ibora.
Bog'lovchi kerak emas — gaplar mazmunan o'zi bog'langan.
Ikkinchi "Moreover" — Band 6 belgisi; "also" fe'ldan oldin turadi.
Bog'lovchi gap ICHIGA ko'chdi va fikr ochildi.
To'rtinchi qo'shish belgisi o'rniga qarama-qarshilik: "however" bu yerda "kutubxona faqat kitob beradi" degan taxminga qarshi turibdi.
"Therefore" va "in my opinion" ketma-ket — ikkita belgi ortiqcha, bittasi yetadi.
Yalang'och "this" + bo'sh gap: hech narsa qo'shmaydi, faqat so'z sarflaydi.
homework.note: Tuzatilgan xatboshining namunasi: Public libraries still matter, even in a city full of screens. They give free access to books for families who could not otherwise buy them, and many also provide internet access and computers. Students, in addition, can study there in a quiet space that a shared flat rarely offers. For these reasons, closing a library saves less money than it appears to. DIQQAT: bu qisqartmada 5-gap (bolalar tadbirlari) tushib qolgan — vazifa 3-4 gap talab qiladi, shuning uchun bu to'g'ri; xohlagan o'quvchi uni "...in a quiet space that a shared flat rarely offers, and many run reading clubs for children." deb qo'shishi mumkin.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Developing Ideas, Using Examples
lessons.grammar_topic: Fikrni ochish zanjiri (because / which means / for example / as a result) va misol tanlash
lessons.vocab_topic: Band 6 va Band 7 orasidagi eng katta farq: aytilgan fikr va ochilgan fikr
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — namuna essay va barcha misol gaplar Jony Academy tomonidan shu dars uchun yozilgan; baholash rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023), Task Response qatori bo'yicha.
objectives: Band 6 va Band 7 orasidagi asosiy farqni bitta jumlada ayta olish: fikr aytilgan emas, OCHILGAN bo'lishi kerak.
Ochish zanjirini yod olish: FIKR (topic sentence) va uning ustiga to'rt bo'g'in — sabab (because), ma'nosi (which means), misol (for example), natija (as a result).
Yassi (rivojlantirilmagan) gapni zanjir bo'yicha to'liq xatboshiga aylantirish.
Kuchli misolning uchta belgisini (aniq, ishonarli, mavzuga bog'liq) tanib olish va zaif misolni tuzatish.
To'qilgan statistikaning xavfini tushunish va uni xavfsiz ifoda bilan almashtirish.
Misol xatboshida BITTA gap bo'lishini bilish (juda zarur bo'lsa — ikkita qisqa gap).
materials: Namuna essay nusxasi (quyidagi [reading] bloki) — har o'quvchiga bittadan, chetida keng bo'sh joy qoldirilgan: zanjir bo'g'inlari shu yerda belgilanadi.
Doskaga DARSDAN OLDIN yozib qo'yiladi: because, which means, for example, as a result — to'rt katak ustma-ust, o'qlari bilan. 5-mashqda shu katakchalar ustiga so'z soni yoziladi.

3-mashq uchun kartochkalar: 9 ta misol gapi qirqilgan holda, 6-8 to'plam (har juftlikka bitta) — o'quvchilar "kuchli" va "zaif" ustunlariga ajratadi. Gaplar aynan 3-mashq ro'yxatidan ko'chiriladi; kartochkada faqat ingliz gapi turadi, javob (KUCHLI/ZAIF) yozilmaydi.
2-mashq uchun yassi gaplar varaqasi: 2-mashqdagi 5 ta yassi gap (faqat chap ustun, javobi yozilmagan), har birining tagida to'rt qatorli bo'sh joy — har o'quvchiga bittadan nusxa.
Ustozda: 37-darsdagi A essay (Band 6) nusxasi — kirishda "misol yo'q" kamchiligini eslatish uchun kerak bo'ladi.
Ikki xil rangli marker: doskada va namuna essay nusxasida sababni va misolni alohida rangda ajratib ko'rsatish uchun.
4-mashqdagi 6 ta xavfli gap: ustoz ularni darsdan oldin doskaning chetiga yozib qo'yadi yoki birma-bir diktovka qiladi — alohida varaq kerak emas.
timeline: 37-darsdagi A essay ochiladi, "misol yo'q" kamchiligi eslatiladi; doskada yassi va ochilgan ikki gap solishtiriladi
Doskadagi to'rt katak: because, which means, for example, as a result — ustoz bitta fikrni sinf bilan birga ochib beradi
Har bo'g'in qaysi ishni bajaradi; iboralar daftarga jadval qilib ko'chiriladi
Varaqadagi 5 gap juftlikda ochiladi; ikkitasi doskada birga tekshiriladi
Kartochkalar ikki ustunga ajratiladi, har qaror uchun sabab aytiladi
Xavfli gaplar xavfsiz akademik ifodaga aylantiriladi
Har body xatboshida fikr va to'rt bo'g'in rangli marker bilan belgilanadi, keyin jadval to'ldiriladi
Qaysi gap qancha joy egallaydi; misol uchdan biridan oshmasligi o'lchab ko'rsatiladi
Zanjir doskadan o'chirilmaydi; uch vazifa o'qib beriladi

intro: 37-darsda ko'rdik: A essay (Band 6) savolga javob bergan, xatboshilari ham bor edi, lekin birorta ham misol yo'q edi. Descriptor tili bilan aytganda — "ideas are insufficiently developed". Bugun aynan shuni tuzatamiz.
Band 6 o'quvchisi fikrni AYTADI: "Tourism helps the local economy." Band 7 o'quvchisi shu fikrni OCHADI: nega shunday, bu nimani anglatadi, qanday holatda, oqibati nima.

Xatboshi FIKR (topic sentence) bilan boshlanadi, keyin uning ustiga to'rt bo'g'inli zanjir quriladi: 1) sabab (because / since / the reason is that), 2) ma'nosi yoki oraliq natija (which means that / this means that / in practice), 3) misol (for example / for instance / in many cities), 4) yakuniy natija (as a result / therefore / consequently). Doskadagi to'rt katak ham aynan shu to'rt bo'g'in.
Har bo'g'inni alohida bog'lovchi bilan boshlash shart emas — muhimi FIKR HARAKATI: umumiydan aniqqa, aniqdan oqibatga. Bog'lovchi shunchaki shu harakatni ko'rsatib turadi.
Kuchli misolning uchta belgisi bor: ANIQ (nima, qayerda, qanday natija bilan), ISHONARLI (hayotda bo'lishi mumkin), MAVZUGA BOG'LIQ (aynan shu fikrni isbotlaydi, boshqasini emas).

To'qilgan statistika xavfli: "According to statistics, 78.4% of tourists..." degan gap tekshiruvchiga ishonarsiz ko'rinadi, ko'pincha til xatosi bilan keladi va fikrni umuman ochmaydi. Aniq foiz o'rniga "a large proportion", "in many cities", "most of these towns" kabi ehtiyotkor ifoda ishlatiladi — ball tushmaydi, xavf esa yo'qoladi.

Shaxsiy tajriba MUMKIN, lekin akademik ohangda: "my friend Dilnoza said" emas, "In my own city, the restored bazaar now houses a library on its upper floor". Ya'ni shaxsiy tajriba umumiy holatga aylantiriladi.

Misol xatboshini egallab olmasligi kerak. Asosiy o'lchov — GAP SONI: to'rt-besh gaplik xatboshida misol BITTA gap (juda zarur bo'lsa ikkita qisqa gap). So'z bo'yicha bu odatda xatboshining chorak qismidan uchdan bir qismigacha chiqadi; foizni sanab o'tirish shart emas. Misoldan keyin ALBATTA fikrga qaytiladi ("as a result", "this suggests that"), aks holda misol osilib qoladi.
Diqqat: bu dars yangi G'OYA o'ylab topish haqida emas. 37-darsda ko'rganimizdek, Band 7.5 essaydagi g'oyalar Band 6 essaydagi bilan bir xil edi — farq faqat ochib berilishida.
formulas: Nega? Bu nimani anglatadi? Qanday holatda? Oqibati nima?
because, which means, for example, as a result
presentation: Har xatboshida misol shartmi?
Body xatboshilarining har birida bitta aniq misol bo'lsin. Kirish va xulosada misol shart emas.
Misol yolg'on bo'lsa, ball tushadimi?
Tekshiruvchi faktni tekshirmaydi. Lekin ishonarsiz misol (aniq foiz, mashhur nom) fikrni ochmaydi va ko'pincha til xatosi bilan keladi — shuning uchun amalda ball tushadi.
Raqam ishlatsam bo'ladimi?
Aniq foiz emas, ehtiyotkor ifoda: a large proportion, most of these towns, in many cities. Ma'no saqlanadi, xavf yo'qoladi.
"I" deb yozsam bo'ladimi?
Ha. "In my view" va "In my own city" mumkin. "My friend said" kabi tasodifiy shaxsiy gap esa misol bo'la olmaydi.
Misol qancha uzun bo'lsin?
Bitta gap. Xatboshi 4-5 gap bo'lsa, bitta misol gapi yetadi; ikkita bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham qisqa bo'lsin, aks holda fikr ko'milib ketadi.
Misoldan keyin nima yoziladi?
Fikrga qaytiladi: as a result, this suggests that, therefore. Misol osilib qolmasligi kerak.
Bir xatboshida ikkita misol bo'lsa?
Bo'ladi, lekin ikkalasi ham qisqa bo'lsin. Ko'pincha bitta ochilgan misol ikkita yuzaki misoldan kuchliroq.
"For example" ni har xatboshida takrorlasam?
Almashtiring: for instance, in many cities, one such case is, a town that... — 37-darsdagi CC talabi aynan shu.
G'oya topolmasam nima qilaman?
Yangi g'oya izlamang. Borini oching: nega, ma'nosi, misol, natija — to'rt savol har doim fikr chiqaradi.
notes: Bu dars 36 va 37-darslar ustiga quriladi: 36 da savol turlari va mezonlar, 37 da baholash berilgan. Bu yerda faqat BITTA mezon — Task Response ning "extends and supports main ideas" qismi ochiladi. Mezonlarni qaytadan tushuntirmang.

Mavzu oilasi: madaniy meros va jamoat puli (eski binolarni ta'mirlash, an'anaviy hunarmandchilik, muzeylar, mahalliy turizm). Bu oila ataylab tanlandi: 36 va 37-darslarda universitet yo'nalishi tanlash mavzusi ishlatilgan, seriyaning qolgan darslarida esa texnologiya, ekologiya va sog'liq mavzulari kutiladi — shuning uchun 44-darsda ular takrorlanmaydi.
Eng katta xato — ustozning o'zi zanjirni to'ldirib yuborishi. Ustoz faqat to'rt savolni beradi (Nega? Ma'nosi nima? Misol? Oqibati?), javobni o'quvchi aytadi.
3-mashqdagi kartochkalar bilan ishlaganda "zaif" deb ajratilganlarini shu yerda TUZATTIRING: har zaif misol yonida kuchli varianti og'zaki aytilsin.
2-mashqda o'quvchilar ko'pincha faqat sababni yozib to'xtaydi. Shunda "va bu nimani anglatadi?" deb so'rang — uchinchi va to'rtinchi bo'g'in shundan chiqadi.

Namuna essay shu dars uchun Jony Academy tomonidan yozilgan. Undagi har body xatboshi ATAYLAB zanjir bo'yicha qurilgan, shuning uchun bo'g'inlar oson topiladi. Buni oldindan aytmang — o'quvchilar o'zi topsin.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Yassi gapni zanjir bilan oching
class_ex.instr: Chapda yassi gap berilgan. Uni to'rt bo'g'in bo'yicha to'liq xatboshiga aylantiring. Har juftlik faqat 1- va 3-gapni yozadi (12 daqiqa), so'ng ikkalasi doskada birga tekshiriladi (6 daqiqa); qolgan uchtasi namuna sifatida ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi va uyda foydalaniladi.
items: Traditional crafts should be taught in schools.
Free entry to museums is a good idea.
answers: Museums are useful for children because they turn a school subject into something that can be seen and touched. This means that a lesson which felt abstract in the classroom becomes memorable. A child who has stood in front of a real loom, for example, is far more likely to remember how cloth was made than one who has only read about it. As a result, museum visits often raise interest in subjects that pupils had previously ignored.

Traditional crafts should be taught in schools because a skill of this kind survives only if it reaches people who are young enough to master it. This means that once a single generation is missed, the craft is effectively lost. In districts where the last workshops have closed, for instance, ceramic techniques have disappeared within one generation. As a result, a few hours of craft teaching each week may protect knowledge that no museum can preserve.

Tourism helps the local economy because visitors spend money on services that cannot be imported, such as food, transport and accommodation. This means that the income stays in the district instead of leaving it. A guesthouse in a small mountain village, for example, may employ four or five neighbours and buy its vegetables from the next street. As a result, even a modest number of visitors can support households that have no other source of cash income.

Old buildings should be protected because a demolished street cannot be rebuilt, however much money is available later. This means that a decision taken in a single year is permanent. Cities that replaced their old centres with office blocks a generation ago, for example, now spend heavily on imitation facades in order to attract the visitors they lost. As a result, protection is almost always cheaper than regret.

Free entry to museums is a good idea because a ticket price discourages exactly the people who would benefit most from visiting. This means that families on low incomes come once a year at best, and often treat the building as somewhere that is not really meant for them. In cities that have dropped their entrance charges, by contrast, the same families return several times a year and come to treat it as an ordinary part of the neighbourhood. As a result, museums gradually build a local audience instead of depending only on tourists.

Misol aniq, lekin to'qilgan raqamsiz — shuning uchun xavfsiz.

Natija gapi qisqa va kuchli — xatboshini yopadi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — har fikr zanjir bilan ochilgan
readings.qtype: Discuss both views and give your own opinion
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi, Band 8 darajasi, 315 so'z — shu dars uchun yozilgan
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some governments spend a large part of their cultural budget on restoring old buildings and supporting traditional crafts. Others argue that this money would be better spent on new housing and modern public services. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: Every year, ministries of culture must decide how much of a limited budget should go towards restoring historic quarters and keeping traditional crafts alive, and how much should be released for housing and everyday public services. Both positions are reasonable, but in my view heritage spending is justified only when it is planned so that the people living nearest to the building benefit directly.

Those who defend heritage spending argue that a restored old quarter is not simply an attraction. Because such a district offers a city something that cannot be copied elsewhere, it draws visitors who stay longer and spend more, which means that money reaches small hotels, cafes and workshops rather than international chains. The old silk-weaving streets of a provincial town, for example, can support dozens of family businesses once the buildings are made safe and the street is paved. As a result, the initial cost of restoration is gradually returned in the form of local wages and local taxes.

The opposing argument is equally practical. Restoration is slow and expensive, while the need for housing is immediate, and a family living in an overcrowded flat cannot wait ten years for a plan to mature. A city that repairs its old market hall while its clinics remain understaffed, for instance, may find that residents come to resent the heritage projects altogether. As a result, the long-term value of these buildings is lost anyway, since a monument that local people dislike is rarely protected once public attention moves elsewhere.

In my view, the two aims should not be separated. Where restoration work creates apprenticeships, houses a clinic or a library on its upper floors, or returns a usable square to a neighbourhood, it pays for itself twice. Heritage budgets should be judged by the same standard as any other public spending, namely what the people nearest to the building actually gain from it.

new housing and modern public services
housing and everyday public services / clinics remain understaffed

homework_intro: Bugun biz yassi fikrni to'rt bo'g'in bilan ochdik: sabab, ma'nosi, misol, natija — uyda xuddi shu zanjirni endi o'zingiz qurasiz.
Birinchi vazifada uchta yassi gap beriladi, har birini to'liq xatboshiga aylantirasiz: kamida to'rt gap va ichida bitta aniq misol bo'lsin, taxminan 25 daqiqa.
Ikkinchi vazifada bitta savolga bitta to'liq body xatboshi yozasiz — 2-mashqdagi tartib bilan, 90-110 so'z, yana 20 daqiqa.

Uchinchi vazifa "misollar banki": daftaringizning oxirgi sahifasiga besh xil mavzu uchun beshta tayyor misol yozib qo'yasiz va har birining yoniga uchta belgini (aniq, ishonarli, mavzuga bog'liq) qo'yasiz.
Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — sababni yozib to'xtab qolish; har xatboshidan keyin o'zingizga ayting: "va bu nimani anglatadi?", "oqibati nima?" — javobi yozilmagan bo'lsa, xatboshi hali tugamagan.

homework.title: Uchta yassi gapni zanjir bilan oching
homework.instr: Har gapni to'liq xatboshiga aylantiring (kamida 4 gap, ichida bitta aniq misol): 1) Museums should stay open in the evening. 2) Local crafts can create jobs for young people. 3) Every city should keep at least one old street.
homework.answers: Namuna (1-gap): Museums should stay open in the evening because most working adults simply cannot visit during office hours. This means that a large part of the population is excluded from institutions their own taxes support. A gallery that opens until nine o'clock twice a week, for example, often finds that its evening visitors are almost entirely local rather than tourists. As a result, evening opening turns a building that serves visitors into one that also serves the city. Namuna (2-gap): Local crafts can create jobs for young people because a workshop needs far more hands than a machine does. This means that a single master taking on apprentices can put four or five school-leavers into paid work. A village that reopened its leather workshop, for instance, now trains three new apprentices every autumn. As a result, craft work keeps young people in towns that would otherwise lose them to the capital. Namuna (3-gap): Every city should keep at least one old street because a place with no visible past gives residents nothing to be proud of. This means that a street of this kind becomes the one part of the city that people bring their guests to see. A district that kept its covered walkway, for example, now holds its weekend market there rather than in a car park. As a result, a single preserved street can do more for a city's identity than a dozen new monuments. Tekshiruv: sabab bormi, ma'nosi bormi, misol aniqmi, natija fikrga qaytdimi.

homework.title: Bitta to'liq body xatboshi yozing
homework.instr: SAVOL: Some people believe that traditional crafts have no place in a modern economy. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Shu savolga BITTA body xatboshi yozing: 90-110 so'z, fikr + to'rt bo'g'in, aniq misol. Misol BITTA gap bo'lsin.
homework.answers: Namuna: Traditional crafts still have a clear economic role, because they produce goods that factories cannot imitate convincingly. This means that a small workshop can charge several times the price of a mass-produced item and still find more buyers than it can supply. A family pottery that supplies a single hotel chain, for instance, may earn more from forty pieces than a factory earns from four hundred. As a result, crafts survive not as a museum exhibit but as a small and profitable part of a modern economy that values what machines cannot copy. (93 so'z; misol — bitta gap, 24 so'z.)

homework.title: Misollar banki: beshta tayyor misol
homework.instr: Daftaringizning oxirgi sahifasiga besh xil mavzu uchun beshta misol yozing (ta'lim, sog'liq, shahar hayoti, ish, madaniyat). Har birining yoniga uchta belgini qo'ying: aniq, ishonarli, mavzuga bog'liq.
homework.answers: Namuna (shahar hayoti): In one district where the main street was closed to cars, local shops reported steadier trade within a year. ANIQ (qayerda va qanday natija), ISHONARLI (hayotda bo'ladigan holat), MAVZUGA BOG'LIQ (transport va savdo haqidagi fikrni isbotlaydi). Ustoz tekshiradi: aniq foizli, manbasiz yoki tasodifiy shaxsiy misollar qaytariladi.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: How to Stop Overgeneralising
lessons.grammar_topic: Mutlaq da'vodan aniq da'voga — hedging (yumshatish) va da'vo doirasini ko'rsatish
lessons.vocab_topic: "All people", "everyone knows", "always" — nega ball tushiradi va o'rniga nima yoziladi
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — barcha gaplar, mashqlar va namuna essay Jony Academy uchun yangidan yozilgan. Mezon nomlari rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) bo'yicha.
objectives: "All people", "everyone knows", "always", "never" kabi mutlaq iboralar essayni nega zaiflashtirishini tushuntirib bera olish.
Hedging to'plamining sakkiz vositasini (tend to, are likely to, in many cases, particularly in, often, may, appear to, a number of) misol bilan ishlatish.
Mutlaq da'voni TASHLAMASDAN, uning doirasini ko'rsatib qayta yozish (kim, qayerda, qachon, nimaga nisbatan).
Berilgan xatboshidan barcha overgeneralisation'larni topib, har birini tuzatilgan variantga almashtirish.
Hedging Task Response va Lexical Resource mezonlarini qanday ko'tarishini band tili bilan ayta olish.
O'z xatboshini yozib, unda kamida to'rtta turli yumshatish vositasini ishlatish.
materials: Namuna essay (quyidagi [reading] bloki) — har o'quvchiga bittadan nusxa, chetida bo'sh ustun: "hedging vositasi".
1-mashq jadvali (Hedging to'plami) — doskaga DARSDAN OLDIN uch ustun chizib qo'yiladi: Vosita | Ma'nosi | Misol. Ustunlar bo'sh, dars davomida to'ldiriladi.
4-mashqdagi besh gap (zaif xatboshi) — A4 ga yirik shriftda chop etiladi, har juftlikka bitta nusxa (guruh 12 kishi bo'lsa 6 nusxa).

Qirqiladigan kartochkalar 3-mashq uchun: bir to'plamda 8 kartochka, har kartochkaning bir tomonida mutlaq so'z, ikkinchi tomonida almashtiruvchisi — all/most; every/almost every; everyone/it is widely believed; always/usually (tend to); never/rarely (seldom); only/one of the main; nobody/few people; completely/largely. Har juftlikka bitta to'plam (guruh 12 kishi bo'lsa 6 to'plam).

37-darsdagi 12 tekshiruv savoli varaqasi — o'quvchilar daftarida bor; dars oxirida undan ikkitasi (TR 3-savol "har fikr sabab yoki misol bilan ochildimi?" va LR 3-savol "so'z birikmalari to'g'rimi?") o'qib eslatiladi.
Qizil ruchka har o'quvchida (5-mashq va uyga vazifa uchun): mutlaq so'zlar aynan qizil bilan aylantiriladi.
timeline: 37-darsdagi 4 mezon eslatiladi; doskaga "All students hate exams" yoziladi va guruh bitta istisno topadi
Mutlaq da'vo = himoyasiz da'vo; "everyone knows" nega dalil emas
Doskadagi uch ustunli jadval to'ldiriladi, 1-mashq daftarga ko'chiriladi
2-mashq juftlikda, keyin har juftlik bittadan gapni doskaga yozadi

Essay o'qiladi, hedging vositalari qizil bilan belgilanadi, ikkala task bajariladi
4-mashq: besh gapli zaif xatboshi tuzatiladi va qayta yoziladi
5-mashq tugamagan bo'lsa shu yerda tugatiladi, aks holda kartochka o'yini takrorlanadi
Almashtirish jadvali doskadan o'qiladi; 37-darsdagi TR va LR tekshiruv savollari eslatiladi; uyga vazifa kirish matni o'qiladi

intro: Task 2 da tekshiruvchi sizdan HAQIQATNI emas, ISBOTLANADIGAN da'voni kutadi. "All students hate exams" degan gapni bitta istisno yiqitadi; "Most students find exams stressful" degan gapni yiqitib bo'lmaydi.
Shuning uchun mutlaq ibora aslida kuchli emas, ZAIF: u o'zini himoya qila olmaydi. Yumshatilgan gap esa kichikroq maydonni egallaydi, lekin o'sha maydonni mustahkam ushlaydi.

"Everyone knows that ..." — eng qimmat xato. Bu ibora dalil o'rnini bosmaydi, aksincha, "menda dalil yo'q" degan signal beradi. 37-darsdagi TR tekshiruv savoli esda: har fikr sabab yoki misol bilan ochildimi?

Hedging = da'voni yumshatish. Qualifying = da'vo doirasini ko'rsatish (kim, qayerda, qachon, nimaga nisbatan). Ikkalasi birga ishlaydi: "Public transport is cheap" -> "Public transport is relatively cheap in most large cities".

DIQQAT: yumshatish fikrdan voz kechish EMAS. "Sugar taxes never work" degan o'quvchi da'vosini tashlamaymiz — uni "Sugar taxes alone rarely produce a large change in behaviour" deb aniqlashtiramiz. Fikr o'sha, lekin endi himoyalangan.

Ball nuqtai nazaridan: hedging TR ni ko'taradi (pozitsiya aniq, lekin haddan oshmagan) va LR ni ko'taradi (tend to, be likely to, appear to, relatively — bular aynan "less common" lug'at). Ya'ni bitta ko'nikma ikki mezonga ishlaydi.

Teskari xavf ham bor: HAMMA gapni yumshatsangiz, pozitsiya yo'qoladi va TR tushadi. 37-darsdagi "It depends on the situation" xulosasi aynan shundan kelib chiqqan. Qoida: pozitsiya gaplari (kirish va xulosadagi fikringiz) aniq bo'ladi, tashqi dunyo haqidagi da'volar yumshatiladi.

Amaliy tartib: essayni yozib bo'lgach, qizil ruchka bilan faqat mutlaq so'zlarni qidiring (all, every, everyone, always, never, only, nobody, completely, totally). Har biri ustida to'xtang va so'rang: "Bunga bitta istisno topsam bo'ladimi?" Topilsa — almashtiring.

Oddiy almashtirish jadvali yod olinadi: all -> most / many; always -> usually / tend to; never -> rarely / seldom; everyone knows -> it is widely believed; the only reason -> one of the main reasons; nobody -> few people.
Bitta xatboshida 2-3 ta yumshatish vositasi yetarli. Har gapda "maybe", "perhaps", "I think" takrorlansa — bu yumshatish emas, ishonchsizlik, va ball tushadi.
formulas: Guruh istisno topsin — da'vo shu zahoti yiqiladi
in most large cities, particularly in, where distances allow
Har hedging vositasi qizil bilan aylantiriladi
Jadvaldagi 10 tasi majburiy, qolgan 4 tasi bonus
Tuzatilgan xatboshi to'liq o'qib beriladi va doskada qoladi
presentation: Yumshatsam, fikrim kuchsiz ko'rinmaydimi?
Aksincha. Mutlaq gapni bitta istisno yiqitadi, yumshatilgan gapni yiqitib bo'lmaydi. Tekshiruvchi buni ehtiyotkorlik emas, aniqlik deb o'qiydi.
"I think" yozsam yumshatish bo'ladimi?
Faqat pozitsiya gapida, bir-ikki marta. Har gapda takrorlansa — ishonchsizlik, TR tushadi. Tashqi da'volar uchun tend to, are likely to ishlating.
Statistikani o'zim o'ylab topsam bo'ladimi?
Aniq raqam (73%, 2019-yilda) yozmang — tekshirib bo'lmaydi. O'rniga "a number of cities", "several studies suggest" deb yozing.
Xulosada ham yumshatamanmi?
Xulosada pozitsiya ANIQ bo'ladi, lekin natija va'dasi yumshatiladi: "I believe" aniq, "is likely to reduce" yumshoq.
Bitta xatboshida nechta yumshatish kerak?
Ikki-uchta yetadi. To'rttadan oshsa, xatboshi suvli bo'lib qoladi va fikr ko'rinmay ketadi.
"Everyone knows" ni umuman ishlatmaymanmi?
Task 2 da ishlatmang. Kerak bo'lsa "it is widely believed that" yoki "it is often argued that" deb yozing.
Bu Lexical Resource ga ham ta'sir qiladimi?
Ha. tend to, be likely to, appear to, relatively, largely — bular kam uchraydigan, to'g'ri ishlatiladigan iboralar, LR ni ko'taradi.
Mutlaq gap umuman yomonmi?
Yo'q. Bahssiz faktlar mutlaq bo'lishi mumkin: "Sugary drinks are sold in almost every country." Yomon bo'lgani — odamlarning xatti-harakati haqidagi mutlaq da'vo.
notes: Bu dars 36- va 37-darslarga suyanadi: mezonlar u yerda tushuntirilgan, bu yerda faqat TR va LR ga tegadigan bitta ko'nikma chuqurlashtiriladi. Mezonlarni qaytadan tushuntirmang, atigi eslatib o'ting.

MAVZU OILASI: darsning ASOSIY mavzusi — jamoat salomatligi va turmush tarzi (shirin ichimliklarga soliq, tez tayyor ovqat, uy ovqati, maktab ovqati, o'tirib ishlash). Namuna essay ham, 4-mashqdagi xatboshi ham shu oiladan. Qolgan mashqlarda BIR-IKKITA yakka gap boshqa mavzularga tegadi: ta'lim (uy vazifasi, ertalabki dars), texnologiya (onlayn xarid, ekran), transport (velosiped yo'llari, jamoat transporti), ish bandligi (ish soatlari). Bular ochib berilmagan, faqat mashq gapi — shuning uchun seriyadagi boshqa darslar bu mavzularni to'liq olsa, takror bo'lmaydi. Atrof-muhit mavzusi bu darsda umuman ishlatilmagan.
Eng ko'p uchraydigan qarshilik: "ustoz, men ishonchim komil edi, nega yumshatay?" Javob doskada tursin: ishonch POZITSIYADA bo'ladi, mutlaqlik DA'VODA bo'lmaydi.
3-mashqni tez sur'atda o'tkazing (har javobga 3 soniya). Sekinlashtirsangiz o'quvchi o'ylab, "xavfsiz" deb javob berib yuboradi; tezlikda esa ular mutlaq so'zni quloq bilan tanib olishni o'rganadi.
Qizil ruchka qoidasini majburiy qiling: bugundan boshlab har yozilgan essayda avval mutlaq so'zlar aylantiriladi, keyin topshiriladi. Bu odat ikki-uch haftada avtomatik bo'lib qoladi.
Kuchli guruhda qo'shimcha: yumshatishni HADDAN OSHIRGAN xatboshi yozdiring (har gapda "maybe", "perhaps", "some people think"), keyin uni o'zlari tuzatsin — teskari xatoni ko'rish juda foydali.
4-mashqdagi tuzatilgan xatboshi to'liq holda doskada qolsin: uyga vazifada o'quvchilar aynan shu namunaga qarab o'z xatboshisini yozadi.

Fikringiz aniq: I believe / In my view
Yumshoq xulosa "It depends" ga aylanadi, bu 6.0 belgisi

Bitta sabab da'vosi eng oson yiqiladigan da'vo

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Mutlaq da'voni qayta yozing
class_ex.instr: Chapdagi mutlaq gapni yumshatib qayta yozing. Fikrni TASHLAMANG — faqat himoyalanadigan qilib aniqlashtiring.
items: All young people today eat fast food every day.
Everyone knows that exercise prevents disease.
People in poor areas cannot cook.
Advertising is the only reason children want sweets.
The government always ignores public health.
answers: Many young people eat fast food several times a week.
Regular exercise is widely believed to reduce the risk of several diseases.
Sugar taxes alone rarely produce a large change in behaviour.
Families in low-income areas often have less time and less access to fresh ingredients.
Advertising is one of the strongest influences on what children ask for.
Governments have often been slow to act on public health.
A diet based mainly on fast food is one of the main causes of obesity.
Relatively few shoppers read nutrition labels carefully.
why: "All" va "every day" — ikkalasi ham bitta istisno bilan yiqiladi.
"Everyone knows" dalil o'rnini bosmaydi; "reduce the risk" aniqroq va to'g'riroq.
Fikr o'sha, lekin "alone" doirani ko'rsatdi, "rarely" mutlaqlikni oldi.
Odamni ayblash emas, sharoitni tasvirlash — TR ham ko'tariladi.
"The only reason" — eng oson yiqiladigan da'vo turi.
"always" -> "often", ustiga zamon ham aniqlashdi.
Sabab zanjiri aniqlashtirildi, bitta mahsulot ayblanmadi.
"Nobody" -> o'lchovli miqdor; "carefully" da'voni yanada aniqlashtiradi.
class_ex.note: Har juftlik bittasini doskaga yozadi. Tekshirishda ikki savol beriladi: 1) fikr saqlanib qoldimi? 2) endi bu gapni yiqitib bo'ladimi?

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Bu gap xavflimi yoki xavfsizmi?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz gapni o'qiydi, o'quvchi 3 soniya ichida "xavfli" yoki "xavfsiz" deb javob beradi va sababini bitta jumlada aytadi.
items: Technology has changed the way we shop.
Everybody agrees that homework is useless.
Most students find it hard to concentrate at home.
Poor people do not care about their health.
Sugary drinks are sold in almost every country.
Any tax will immediately reduce consumption.
In many countries, fresh food costs more than processed food.
Children today are completely addicted to screens.
Working hours have increased in some sectors.
why: Umumiy, lekin bahssiz va tekshiriladigan fakt.
"Everybody agrees" isbotsiz; ustiga "useless" bo'sh baho.
"Most" o'lchovli — da'vo himoyalangan.
Ham mutlaq, ham hurmatsiz umumlashtirish — TR ni tushiradi.
Faktik da'vo, "almost" bilan yanada xavfsiz.
Ikkita mutlaq so'z birga: "any" va "immediately".
Doirasi ko'rsatilgan: "in many countries".
"Completely addicted" — tibbiy atama bo'sh ishlatilgan.
Qayerda, qanday sharoitda — ko'rsatilmagan; bu gap 5-mashqda tuzatiladi.
"Some sectors" doirani cheklaydi.
class_ex.note: Kartochkalar shu mashqda ishlatiladi. Gap "xavfli" deb topilgach, juftlik o'sha mutlaq so'z kartochkasini ko'taradi va orqa tomonidagi almashtiruvchisini ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi (Everybody uchun "everyone" kartochkasi ishlatiladi). To'plamda yo'q so'zlar ham bor — "any tax", "immediately", "do not care": ularda kartochka ko'tarilmaydi, o'quvchi almashtiruvchisini o'zi aytadi (some taxes, over time, have less time and money). Ustoz bu uchtasini oldindan bilib tursin.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Xatboshidan overgeneralisation'larni toping
class_ex.instr: Quyidagi besh gap — bitta zaif xatboshi (ketma-ket o'qilsa, to'liq xatboshi chiqadi). Har gapdagi mutlaq iborani qizil bilan aylantiring va tuzatilgan variantini yozing.
items: 1-gap: Everyone knows that office work is destroying our health.
2-gap: All office workers sit for eight hours and never move.
3-gap: This always leads to serious illness.
4-gap: Companies do nothing about the problem.
5-gap: Therefore, the only solution is to ban desk jobs.
answers: Mutlaq: "Everyone knows" va "destroying". Tuzatilgani: There is growing evidence that long periods of sitting at work can damage health.
Mutlaq: "All" va "never". Tuzatilgani: Many office workers sit for most of the day and move very little.
Mutlaq: "always" va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sabab. Tuzatilgani: Over time, this is likely to increase the risk of serious illness.
Mutlaq: "do nothing". Tuzatilgani: Employers, however, have often been slow to respond.
Mutlaq: "the only solution" va amalga oshmaydigan taklif. Tuzatilgani: A more practical response would be to redesign the working day so that staff move regularly.
why: Da'vo saqlandi, lekin endi dalil tilida yozilgan.
Miqdor realga aylandi, da'vo tekshiriladigan bo'ldi.
Sabab o'rniga ehtimollik — himoyalangan da'vo.
Ayblovdan kuzatuvga o'tildi; bog'lovchi gap ichiga kirdi.
Xulosa real taklifga aylandi.
class_ex.note: ZAIF XATBOSHI to'liq holda (ustoz aynan shuni doskaga yozadi yoki A4 da tarqatadi, javoblarsiz): "Everyone knows that office work is destroying our health. All office workers sit for eight hours and never move. This always leads to serious illness. Companies do nothing about the problem. Therefore, the only solution is to ban desk jobs." Qizil aylanadigan 7 ta ibora aniq: 1) Everyone knows 2) is destroying 3) All 4) never 5) always 6) do nothing 7) the only solution — o'quvchi shu yettitasini topsa, mashq bajarilgan. TUZATILGAN XATBOSHI ketma-ket o'qilganda: "There is growing evidence that long periods of sitting at work can damage health. Many office workers sit for most of the day and move very little. Over time, this is likely to increase the risk of serious illness. Employers, however, have often been slow to respond. A more practical response would be to redesign the working day so that staff move regularly." Ustoz uni doskaga yozib, dars oxirigacha qoldiradi (uyga vazifa uchun namuna).

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Da'voni tashlamang — doirasini ko'rsating
class_ex.instr: Bu safar yumshatish emas, ANIQLASHTIRISH: kim, qayerda, qachon, nimaga nisbatan. Har gapga kamida bitta doira qo'shing.

In cities with separate cycle lanes, cycling carries a lower risk of serious injury than driving.

why: Doira: qayerda. Istisno ham aytildi.
Doira: kim va qachon.
"Healthier" nimaga nisbatan — solishtiruv aniqlashtirildi.
Bo'sh "good" o'rniga ikkita aniq foyda.
Kutilgan natija kamtarona, shuning uchun ishonarli.
Shart qo'shildi — endi da'vo himoyalangan.
Buyruq shartli tavsiyaga aylandi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — hedging amalda
readings.qtype: Jony Academy namuna essayi, Band 7.5 darajasi
readings.source: Jony Academy uchun yangidan yozilgan (286 so'z). Essayda ataylab 14 ta yumshatish va aniqlashtirish vositasi bor.
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people think that governments should place heavy taxes on fast food and sugary drinks in order to improve public health. Others believe that such taxes punish ordinary families and achieve very little. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: Rates of diet-related illness have risen sharply in many middle-income countries over the past two decades, and taxing fast food and sweetened drinks is often proposed as a remedy. Although such taxes are unlikely to solve the problem on their own, I believe that they can form a useful part of a wider public health strategy.

Supporters of taxation point to price sensitivity. Where a product becomes noticeably more expensive, consumption tends to fall, at least in the short term, and this effect appears to be strongest among younger buyers, who usually have the least money to spend. Several cities that have introduced a levy on sweetened drinks have reported a measurable drop in sales, and a number of manufacturers have responded by reducing the sugar content of their products rather than losing customers. Even a modest change of this kind, repeated across millions of purchases, is likely to matter more than campaigns that simply ask people to eat better.

Critics, however, raise a fair objection. A flat tax takes a larger share of income from poorer households, particularly in areas where fresh food is expensive or difficult to obtain. In such neighbourhoods a higher price may cause real hardship without changing behaviour very much, since cheap processed food is often the only realistic option. Taxation on its own, in other words, tends to treat the symptom rather than the cause.

In my view, these two positions are not incompatible. A tax is most defensible when the money it raises is returned to the communities that pay it, for instance through subsidised school meals or support for local markets. Used in this way, taxation is likely to encourage healthier choices without leaving low-income families worse off.
paraphrases: taxing fast food and sweetened drinks / a levy on sweetened drinks
a wider public health strategy / encourage healthier choices
takes a larger share of income from poorer households
unlikely to solve the problem on their own
glossary: flat tax — hamma uchun bir xil stavkali soliq

tasks.title: Essaydagi yumshatish vositalarini toping
tasks.instr: Har qatorni essaydan topib, qizil bilan aylantiring. Uchinchi ustunni avval o'quvchilar o'zi to'ldiradi, keyin solishtiriladi.
tasks.answers: Jadvalning ikkinchi va uchinchi ustunlari javob. Qolgan 4 vosita (jami 14 ta) o'quvchi mustaqil topadi: "in many middle-income countries" (doira), "is often proposed" (often), "without changing behaviour very much" (natija yumshatilgan), "taxation is likely to encourage healthier choices" (xulosadagi ikkinchi "likely to").
tasks.note: Kim 12 tadan ko'p topsa — maqtang. 14 tasining hammasi topilishi shart emas, muhimi: o'quvchi endi bu vositalarni matnda KO'RADI. MUHIM OGOHLANTIRISH: essaydagi "I believe" va "In my view" yumshatish vositasi EMAS — bu pozitsiya belgisi va u ataylab aniq qoldirilgan. Kimdir ularni qizil bilan aylantirsa, darhol to'g'rilang: pozitsiya aniq, da'volar yumshoq. "For instance" ham yumshatish emas — u misol keltirish vositasi.

tasks.title: Agar mutlaq yozilganda nima bo'lardi?
tasks.instr: Chapda essaydagi gap, o'ngda uning mutlaq varianti. Har juftlikda so'rang: qaysi birini yiqitish oson?
items: Such taxes are unlikely to solve the problem on their own.
Consumption tends to fall, at least in the short term.
This effect appears to be strongest among younger buyers.
A higher price may cause real hardship without changing behaviour very much.
Cheap processed food is often the only realistic option.

answers: Mutlaq varianti: Such taxes do not work.

Mutlaq varianti: A higher price only causes hardship.
